scope: Bounded source-only post-review outline invalidation and timing diagnostic delta, three paths

sourceChecks.result: The dirty region is the union of previous/current clipped outlines, with conservative logical-pixel raster margins. Each move contributes both rings to QWidget pending invalidation; successive coalesced moves preserve earlier dirty rings. The Source-mode transparent clear respects widget paint clipping, then the newest selection is redrawn. Empty/small clipped rectangles keep conservative outer coverage. No stale-stroke defect is supported by this delta.

The new checks observe queued paint regions and X11 window backing pixels for grow/shrink, avoiding render() between those transitions. They assert erased old right/bottom strokes, current white stroke, and interior exclusion. This is isolated backing-pixel proof; it does not prove native compositor presentation, HiDPI or cross-output repaint behavior.

Hotkey, press/drag, cancellation, 35 invocations with 5 warmups, 30-sample p95 index 28 and <=150ms gate are unchanged. New costs/timestamps use the same monotonic elapsed timer and remain included in paintMs. Ownership-query time is explicitly a subset of event-drain time; first-white times are driver-observed drawable evidence, explicitly not compositor presentation. Do not sum overlapping cost fields or subtract them to assert renderer latency.

acceptance.testEvidence: Root reports Dev4/4 and focused red-to-green; not executed or independently validated by this review.

limitations: Existing reviewer context reused; no fresh-context independence claim. Reviewer authored none of these three delta paths but has prior Cinnamon audit/review context.
Only packet before/after, manifest, brief and patch inspected; no canonical/source/index changes, product builds/tests/runtime, UI/VM operations or new peer job.
Original frozen23-path review.json is preserved; this artifact does not rewrite it. Full graphical/compositor matrix and 40MiB gates remain open.
